transcriber_notes: Very low-resolution (393x414) JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style form; no branding -> source_format 'other'. Most text blurred; tentative header readings in header.notes. Height axis 1.475 px/cm (0 cm at y386). Bars start at ~144 cm (the dashed line at 150 cm is the top of the surface row); boundaries from bar edges and leader lines +-1.5 cm: 144/132/113.5/112.5/104/52.5/20/0. Hardness origin at the right plot edge (F/4F/1F/P/K ~7/14/29/58/116 px): F, 1F, F (thin SH bar), 1F+, P, P, 1F; R-column icons agree. Air temp: printed value blurred (reads -9.0/-8.0); the dashed air line starts at -9.1 C on the 7.5 px/deg C scale (0 C at the 4F gridline), so -9.0 recorded. Temperatures only where circles are visible (+-0.3 C, +-1.5 cm); the line continues to ~-1 C at the ground without visible markers below 80 cm.
